issues.description: Ride constructor signature in the solution violates the UML/problem requirement. The UML defines Ride with attributes name:String and abbreviation:char, and the problem statement requires a public constructor taking all UML attributes in order. However, solution_repository/src/de/tum/in/ase/Ride.java defines `public Ride(String name)` and hard-codes `abbreviation = 'A'`, so subclasses cannot properly pass the required abbreviation value via the superclass constructor.
issues.suggestedFix: Update Ride to `public Ride(String name, char abbreviation)` assigning both fields. Remove the hard-coded abbreviation. Ensure all subclasses call `super(name, abbreviation)` (RollerCoaster already does; LaunchedDropdownTower will then compile against the corrected Ride constructor).
